policy: Ratchet rule: a PR that lowers any baseline below its floor or fails a fixture assertion must update this manifest in the same PR with a justification. New failure modes get a fixture entry BEFORE the fix (test-first). Holdout clips are never tuned against — thresholds and models are fitted on core only; holdout is reported for honesty.

tiers.core: verified strike-truth clips; thresholds/models may be tuned against these
tiers.holdout: verified strike-truth clips added after rules-4 tuning; report-only, never fit
tiers.regression/tracking: clips quarantined for tracking/identity failures; not scored for strike metrics until re-ID lands
